content: A daily protein intake of 2.5 grams per kilogram of body weight, or approximately 15-20% of total caloric intake, has been shown to improve health outcomes in individuals with diabetes. Protein intake recommendations should be tailored to each individual, taking into account their specific dietary patterns and personal needs. Some research suggests that slightly higher protein consumption, in the range of 20-30% of total caloric intake, may help in the management of type 2 diabetes and contribute to increased feelings of satiety.
